Nucor Corporation (NYSE: NUE) announced today that the Company's Towers & Structures business unit will build its third state-of-the-art utility structures production facility in Brigham City, Utah.
The Utah facility will be located on Nucor’s existing Brigham City campus, located at 1050 Watery Lane.
Nucor subsequently built new Towers & Structures facilities in Alabama and Indiana and is currently constructing another facility in Utah.
Current production facilities are in West Hazleton, PA, Decatur, AL, Crawfordsville, IN and Brigham City, UT with plans to build a national footprint.
The facility will manufacture overhead powerline support structures.
It will receive plate and sheet products from Nucor steel mills via rail to meet its raw material needs.
